description: Verify that checkByteOrder replies with UInt32 BE sum of UInt8+UInt16 BE inputs
approach:
[Objective]
Byte-order canon: DUT receives UInt8+UInt16 in BE wire form, computes their sum as UInt32 BE — verifies the deserialiser+serialiser endianness across multi-width arithmetic.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: Method Request (per-case shape).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: Method Response (or absence) per the asserted behaviour.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted response satisfies the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase2_payload_mismatch: checkByteOrder response did not match expected UInt32 sum
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_response: No Method Response within listen window
